lines: +const corrections = detectMemoryCorrections(created, correctionPool, { newId: ulid, recordedAt: timestamp });
note: Reviewed (N6 correction priority, owner approval 2026-11-21): after the MemoryObjects of a Capture are built, each NEW Memory is checked (code only, lib/correction.ts, no AI call) for the user's verbatim correction of an earlier record's reason or of an AI reflection, and the correction links are attached to the new Memory as the additive `corrections` field. The corrected record's text is never rewritten; a failed pool read leaves the Capture result exactly as before. Exact added lines of capture.ts only (never a pattern); comment lines of the block are covered by the existing comment allowance.
